text: INCOIS provides Potential Fishing Zone advisories using ocean observations including satellite-derived sea surface temperature and chlorophyll information. ORCA uses the advisory as ocean evidence and exposes its availability and timestamp.
INCOIS ocean-state products include marine parameters such as wind, waves, currents, sea surface temperature and related ocean conditions.
MOSDAC is an ISRO data access gateway for meteorological and ocean-related satellite data products. ORCA keeps MOSDAC as an authoritative gateway in the product architecture.
IMD marine forecast products are an authoritative warning and forecast gateway. ORCA's IMD adapter is configuration-driven.
GIS boundary and thematic layers provide geographic context. ORCA separates configured GIS evidence from demo geometry.

The deterministic Risk Engine combines supplied evidence and explicit prototype thresholds to classify SAFE, CAUTION, UNSAFE, BLOCKED or DATA_UNAVAILABLE. The explanation model cannot override the classification.
ORCA is a decision-support prototype. Demo thresholds and straight-line route calculations are not official maritime regulations or operational navigation instructions.
ORCA supports English, Telugu and Hindi response modes. Intent classification includes multilingual keyword handling and the UI supports browser voice input and speech output.
